professionalSummary.text: Product Manager with experience owning the onboarding roadmap and driving activation metrics for a whiteboard app.

experienceHighlights.text: Designed and executed four onboarding experiments in collaboration with a data analyst, including hypothesis, variants, and stopping rules.
experienceHighlights.witness: Designed four onboarding experiments with the data analyst, writing the hypothesis, the variants and the stopping rule for each before launch.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted monthly interviews with six to eight new users and shared findings with the team via summaries and video clips.
experienceHighlights.witness: Interviewed six to eight new users every month and posted a summary of the findings in the team channel with clips from the recordings.

experienceHighlights.text: Collaborated with lifecycle marketing to review and refine the welcome‑email sequence, including updating the second email to link to the template gallery.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the welcome-email sequence with the lifecycle-marketing manager and changed the second email to link to the template gallery.
